say.text: Then Isa went to Shihab ad-Din al-Harimi, Salah ad-Din's uncle on his mother's side.
Here is Salah ad-Din, your sister's son. What he has is yours. Now that the power is in his hands, do not be the first to take it from him: it would never come to you.
My sister's son. I held him on my knee. He had a toy sword then, and a great deal to say.
Isa did not stop until he had brought him before Salah ad-Din to take the oath of fidelity.
Nephew. I do not come as your uncle. I come as your man. Hold out your hand.
